source.publisher: Lurgan Mail (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: names from the OCR text, which is clean; returned unopposed, no poll

note: Triennial election of the rural district council (ten electoral divisions), 1933: there was no election. The report prints no party labels. Returned unopposed. J. G. Gracey: no party label printed in 1933. At other elections he stood as Unionist (Kernan, Armagh County Council, 29 May 1930, printed 'U': Belfast News-Letter, 30 April 1930, p. 15 ("Apathy in Rural Districts"); withdrawals from the Lurgan Mail, 10 May 1930, p. 4 ("No Contests in Armagh: County Council Nominees Withdraw"); Kernan, Armagh County Council, 25 May 1933, printed 'U': Lurgan Mail, 29 April 1933, p. 3 ("County and Rural Council Elections"); Kernan, Armagh County Council, 28 May 1936, printed 'U': Lurgan Mail, 2 May 1936, p. 4 ("Local Government Nominations: Armagh County Council"); Armagh Guardian, 1 May 1936, p. 6 ("The Elections")).
